WeatherNative

A native Android weather application built with React Native featuring real-time weather tracking and a clean, modern UI.

GitHub Repository↓ Download APK

Problem Solved

Traditional weather apps often feel bloated with ads or clunky interfaces. WeatherNative provides a highly responsive, minimal, and visually pleasing native experience on Android. It leverages location-aware live tracking and dynamic backgrounds to create a seamless user experience.
